name: Confirmation Sampler
description: A Sampler that generates samples of experimental conditions with the objective of maximizing the (approximated) loss of a model relating experimental conditions to observations. The samples are generated by first training a neural network to approximate the loss of a model for all patterns in the training data. Once trained, the network is then provided with the candidate samples of experimental conditions and the selects those with the highest loss.

sample.name: metadata
sample.description: Meta-data about the dependent and independent variables specifying the experimental conditions

sample.name: training_epochs
sample.description: Number of epochs to train the popper network for approximating the error of the model

sample.name: training_lr
sample.description: Learning rate for training the popper network

sample.name: plot
sample.description: Print out the prediction of the popper network as well as its training loss

variables.name: conditions
variables.description: The candidate samples of experimental conditions to be evaluated.

variables.name: model
variables.description: Scikit-learn model, could be either a classification or regression model

variables.name: reference_conditions
variables.description: Experimental conditions that the model was trained on

variables.name: reference_observations
variables.description: Observations that the model was trained to predict
